where: Timed sim: SIMT interval -> simAdvance + simRender (ui8.js ~l.91-105)
what: The sim re-renders the whole #v-cases view with innerHTML every 3 s (simPace 3). Each re-render destroys the focused button, so keyboard focus drops to <body> every 3 s, and a screen reader loses its reading position. A keyboard-only or screen-reader user cannot reach or press the action buttons. The sim is unusable without a mouse or touch.
evidence: Playwright 1280x800: openCase("sim-dka"), focus the "Venous gas" button. Focus stays on it at 1 s and 2 s, then document.activeElement = BODY at 3, 4 and 5 s. The next Tab lands on "← Cases" (top of the page).
fix: Render the sim skeleton once. On each tick, update only the clock text, the vitals (.vits), the severity bar, Results and Events in place, keyed by id. Leave the action buttons in the DOM, and only toggle .done/disabled on them. If a full re-render is kept, save document.activeElement (data-act key) before and re-focus the same action after. Put the Events list in role="log" aria-live="polite" (announce only the newest event) and the Results in aria-live="polite".

what: caseEnd() writes progress (S.cases[id].n++, S.sess.push, touchDay, addXP) every time the completion screen renders. Any re-render while CS sits past the last step counts the case again: XP, session count and run count inflate.
evidence: Finish ch-meth (XP 20 -> 40), then go("today"); location.hash="#cases" -> completion screen re-renders, XP 60 and S.cases["ch-meth"].n=2. Calling RENDER.cases() on the completion screen: XP 15->30->45, sess 1->2->3 (run1.py/run2.py in scratchpad/beta/t20).
fix: Record the result once, at the moment the last step is solved (e.g. in the csNext/Finish handler set CS.done=true and write S.cases/S.sess/XP there), and make caseEnd() purely render from CS. Guard with if(!CS.recorded){...;CS.recorded=1}.

what: Autopsy chip ("Why did you pick it?") does nothing on a redo. The handler finds the notebook entry with (S.cmist).find(x=>x.key===cid:i:k), which returns the OLDEST entry with that key; if that one already has a why (or was removed), the new entry never gets its reason, yet the chip shows as pressed.
evidence: Pick the same wrong option in ch-dka step 1 twice (first run and "Redo the case"), choose "Didn't know the rule" then "Arithmetic slip": S.cmist keys = ["ch-dka:0:1=rule","ch-dka:0:1=undefined"].
fix: Store the new entry id on CS (e.g. CS.mid[CS.i+":"+i]=entry.id in caseAnswer) and have the chip look it up by id; or use findLast with !x.del. Count S.why only once per entry.

what: The printout's random rows are regenerated every time caseStep re-renders, i.e. each time the learner taps an answer. The 'photo' changes under them: after a wrong answer, Hb, Crea, COHb, MetHb, Temp rows appear, vanish or change value (one render added 'Crea 161 H').
evidence: openCase('im-print'); read .printout text; caseAnswer(wrong); read again → different rows (t0 had Temp 36.3, COHb 1.6 H; t1 had MetHb 0.9, Crea 161 H, Hb 13.8).
fix: Cache the generated HTML per step: e.g. CS.img=CS.img||{}; CS.img[CS.i]=CS.img[CS.i]||caseImg(st.img). Combined with deterministic extras (finding above).

what: The 68%/72% value is the oxyhaemoglobin FRACTION (FO₂Hb = O₂Hb/total Hb), not SaO₂. A co-oximeter's sO₂ (functional, O₂Hb/(O₂Hb+HHb)) would read ≈ 99–100% here at PaO₂ 410/96. This is exactly the misconception Toffaletti 2007 (cited by both cases) warns about. The im-co question also calls the same number 'oxyhaemoglobin 72%', so image and stem disagree.
evidence: Screenshots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T21-im-syringe-s2-390-light.png, /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T21-im-co-s1-full390.png. Toffaletti & Zijlstra, Anesth Analg 2007;105:S5–S9.
fix: Relabel the row 'FO₂Hb (oxyhaemoglobin %)'; optionally add a fifth row 'sO₂ (calc. from PaO₂) 100%' to show the full saturation gap. Use the same wording in the c12.js stems.

where: Chat and image cases: case step answer (#v-cases .opt)
what: After an answer in a chat or image case, focus is lost (the focused button is disabled or re-rendered). The "What happens" and "Right." feedback is not announced. New chat bubbles are added to .chat, which is not a log or live region.
evidence: chat.py: openCase("ch-dka"), Enter on option 1 -> activeElement BODY. .chat has no role or aria-live.
fix: Give .chat role="log" aria-live="polite". Put the step feedback in role="status". Move focus to the feedback paragraph or to #csNext after an answer.

what: The Key steps table in the sim debrief is not wrapped in .tw, and .tbl has min-width:420px, so on phones the whole page scrolls sideways (72 px at 390, 102 px at 360) and the 'You' column ('missed') is off screen.
evidence: openCase('sim-sepsis'); simEnd('end') at 390×844: documentElement.scrollWidth − clientWidth = 72. Shot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-sim-debrief-390x844-pixel-dark-end.png (target column clipped at the card edge).
fix:
Wrap the table in `
…
` like the lesson tables, or give it `class="tbl" style="min-width:0"` with the target column `white-space:nowrap`.

where: Timed sim · simGas() (fio2 copied from case.gas0)
what: Simulated gases ignore the oxygen you have given. In Resus 1 (septic shock) I gave 'Oxygen to SpO₂ 94–98%' at 4′. Both the 5′ ABG and the 31′ repeat ABG print 'ARTERIAL · FIO₂ 0.21' with PaO₂ 62 and 65. That is an SpO₂ of about 91–92%, below the target the action claims. The P/F and A–a from these gases teach the wrong thing.
evidence: openCase('Resus 1') → Oxygen → ABG with lactate → … → Repeat ABG. CS.done.o2 = 1 at t = 4, but the result header reads FiO₂ 0.21. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T30-sim2.png
fix: In simGas, set g.fio2 from the oxygen actions (for example 0.4 after 'Oxygen to SpO₂ 94–98%'). Raise PaO₂ to match the target, or let the case data give gas1 values for 'on O₂'. Show the device in the header.

where: Timed sim · simVit() / first render vs case vignette (c12 Resus 1)
what: The monitor at 00:00 disagrees with the vignette above it. The vignette says HR 126, BP 78/42, RR 28. The monitor says HR 137, BP 65 sys, RR 33, SpO₂ 88, GCS 10. BP is shown as systolic only, but the treatment target is 'MAP ≥ 65', so the learner cannot check the target.
evidence: Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T30-sim1.png
fix: Start the vitals from the vignette values at t = 0 and drift them from there. Show BP as sys/dia (MAP) and colour by MAP.

what: The chat case debrief is one line ('2 wrong turns. They are in your mistake notebook.') plus a collapsed Sources list. There are no take-home points, no summary of the right path and no exam angle. Confetti fires even after wrong turns. For a learner, the debrief is where the learning sticks.
evidence: Nineteen and vomiting → finish with 2 wrong turns. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T30-chat-debrief.png
fix: Add 'c.learn' (3 teaching points) and 'c.exam' (the one fact an MRCEM or USMLE question would test) to each case in c12.js and render them here. Also show the path taken vs the ideal path, the exam tags and the sources open by default. Skip confetti when there are wrong turns.

what: After you pick an autopsy reason, any re-render (answering the right option next) redraws the chips enabled and unpressed. Your choice disappears from view, and clicking another chip seems to work but is ignored because e.why is already set.
evidence: ch-dka step 1: wrong pick, click "Didn't know the rule", then press the right option: chips return as disabled=false / aria-pressed=null (run1.py autAfterRight).
fix: In autopsyRow(k), look up the notebook entry for this key and render aria-pressed="true" on its why, with all chips disabled when a why exists.

what: On a phone each new step scrolls to the top, so the new message and question sit below the fold behind the full intro and the growing chat history. From step 2 onwards you must scroll to find what changed.
evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T20-dka-step2-gas.png (390x844): question "Read it." at y ~1080.
fix: After Next, scroll the newest bubble (or the .scn-step card) into view: el.querySelector(".chat .bub:last-child")?.scrollIntoView({block:"start"}). Collapse the intro card to one line after step 1.

what: Earlier gases vanish once you move on: the history replays only the bubbles and your answer. ch-dka step 4 ("six hours later...") asks you to judge the trend, but the first VBG is no longer on screen.
evidence: ch-dka step 4: only the step-2 "VBG is back." bubble remains; the slip is gone.
fix: In hist, render a compact gas chip for any earlier step that had s.gas (e.g. "VBG: pH 7.08 · PCO2 19 · HCO3 5.6 · AG 29") that expands to the full slip on tap.

what: After an answer the whole view re-renders. Focus drops to <body> and nothing is announced (no aria-live), so keyboard users lose their place and screen-reader users never hear "Right" or "What happens".
evidence: Press 1 in ch-meth: document.activeElement = BODY; #v-cases [aria-live] count = 0.
fix: Wrap the feedback in <div aria-live="polite">. After re-render, focus #csNext if solved, otherwise the first enabled option.

what: Browser/Android Back from Settings can reopen a different, older case. openCase replaces the hash in place, so the earlier #case-<id> entry stays in history and its hashchange starts that case from step 1.
evidence: Fresh load #case-ch-pca, finish ch-copd, tap gear, press Back: URL #case-ch-pca and ch-pca restarts (run2.py afterGearBack).
fix: When leaving a case (csBack, caseEnd "All cases", gear), replaceState the entry to #cases. Or have route() on #case-<id> with VIEW!=="cases" ask "Resume?" instead of silently opening a different case.

what: Removing a notebook entry re-renders the library and collapses the notebook <details>. With 16 tiles above it on a phone, every removal means scrolling to the bottom and reopening it.
evidence: After clicking Remove: details.open=false (run1.py afterRemove). /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T20-lib-notebook.png shows the notebook at the very bottom of a 3300 px page.
fix: Remove the .nbi node in place (or keep a S.ui.nbOpen flag and render <details open>). Move the notebook above the tiles, or add a "Mistakes · n" chip in the header that jumps to it.

what: CS.log (question, your answer, right first time) is collected but never used. The completion screen shows only "1 wrong turn" and gives no step-by-step debrief.
evidence: ui8.js line 57 pushes CS.log; caseEnd never reads it.
fix: On the completion screen, list each step's question with a tick or cross and the one-line explanation. This is the learning moment of a case.

where: capnoSVG value label and trace height
what: The top-right number (48, 36, 0) has no label and no y-axis scale; the shark-fin trace (48) and the cleft trace (36) peak at the same height, so the number and the picture disagree. Grid lines are unlabelled; no time axis/RR.
evidence: Screenshots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T21-im-capno-s1-1280-dark.png, /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T21-im-capno-s3-1280-dark.png.
fix: Add y-axis ticks (0, 25, 50 mmHg) on the grid lines and scale `top` from the ETCO₂ value (y = base − etco2/50×(base−top0)). Show 'ETCO₂ 48  RR 14' as a monitor-style numeric box.

where: capnoSVG / monitorSVG / question text in kPa mode
what: With Settings units = kPa, the monitor shows 'PaO₂ 54.7 kPa' and printouts show kPa, but the stems still say 'PaO₂ 410', 'PO₂ 38, PCO₂ 48', 'PO₂ 142'; the capnograph label is hard-wired 'ETCO₂ · mmHg'.
evidence: S.units='kPa'; open im-syringe step 2 / im-print step 2: monitor 54.7 kPa vs stem 'PaO₂ 410'.
fix: Template the numbers in c12.js stems through P()/PU() (e.g. q:()=>'PaO₂ '+P(410)+' '+PU()), or remove numbers from stems (see the image-led stem finding). Make capnoSVG use PU() and convert 48→6.4, 36→4.8 kPa.

what: Only the methaemoglobin syringe is ever drawn; the arterial and venous colours exist in the code but are not shown, so the learner cannot compare. The barrel also shows a white gap between the blood and the plunger rod with no rubber stopper, which reads as air in the syringe (a sampling error in a blood-gas app).
evidence: Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T21-im-syringe-s1-1280-dark.png.
fix: Draw three labelled syringes (A arterial, B venous, C unknown) with an 'after shaking in air' swatch row: arterial bright red, venous reddens, MetHb stays brown. Add a dark stopper rect at x≈194 adjacent to the blood.

what: Not realistic: only 4 pads; real strips (Multistix 10 SG, Combur-10) have 10 pads incl. pH, SG, leucocytes, nitrite; strips carry no printed labels or '+++' (you read against the bottle chart). The '+++' labels give the answer away. pH and SG are relevant here (acidic, concentrated urine in rhabdomyolysis).
evidence: Screenshots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T21-im-dip-s1-1280-light.png. Siemens Multistix 10 SG chart order: glucose, bilirubin, ketone, SG, blood, pH, protein, urobilinogen, nitrite, leucocytes.
fix: Draw a 10-pad strip without labels beside a simplified bottle colour chart (rows per test, neg→+++ swatches) so the learner matches colours; set pH 5.5, SG 1.030, leucocytes/nitrite neg.

what: Each finished library case adds its number of steps (n=c.steps.length) to the day's gas count, so one case shows as '6 gases' on the heatmap and towards the 15/day goal.
evidence: ui8.js:61 touchDay(n) with n=c.steps.length.
fix: Use touchDay(1) per case (one gas), or show cases separately.

what: Abnormal vitals are flagged only by colour, and the screen-reader text runs together: "HR 131 /min BP 91 sys …", with no "abnormal" or "high" marker. The clock "Time 00:06" is not a timer. Results arriving ("Result: Venous gas") are not announced.
evidence: snap-sim.txt. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T27-ans-sim-light.png.
fix: Render each vital as <div role="group" aria-label="Heart rate 133 per minute, high">, and add a visible ▲/▼. Announce new results through the Events log (see the critical sim finding).

what: S.ui.simPace is read by the sim timer but nothing in the UI sets it, so it is dead config, and a bad value from a synced state stops the sim clock (see above).
evidence: grep: simPace appears only in ui8.js:105.
fix: Either add a pace control (for example Calm 1×, Shift 2×, Resus 3×) that validates to an integer, or remove the lookup and use a constant.

what: After a wrong pick, the case shows 'What happens: …' and a 'Why did you pick it?' block, and leaves the options open to retry. After the right pick, the 'Right.' text appears above the earlier wrong-answer blocks, so the page reads out of order. It is also never said plainly that the pick was wrong.
evidence: Nineteen and vomiting, step 2, picks 2 then 1 then 3. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T30-chat-wrong.png
fix: Prefix wrong feedback with 'Not this one.' (as Speed does). Collapse earlier wrong blocks into one line ('You first chose …') above the final 'Right.'

what: The clock runs 1 real second = 1 sim minute but displays '00:14', which reads as seconds. Nothing explains the speed. The live EVENTS list shows only the last 6 events, so 'Oxygen' had dropped off by 14′.
evidence: Resus 1, CS.t vs the display. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T30-sim2.png
fix: Show 'T+14 min' and add a note: 'Sim time: 1 s = 1 min. Pause any time.' Make the events list scroll rather than truncate.

what: Speaker styling is binary: "Patient" and "Brother" get a teal border, and Nurse, Midwife, Lab and Paramedic all look identical. Any new relative ("Wife", "Mother") would be styled as staff.
evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T20-dka-wrong.png; ui8.js line 39 hard-codes ['Patient','Brother'].
fix: Add an explicit side flag in the data (m:[["Brother","...","them"]]) or a lookup of lay speakers; give Lab/results a distinct "system" bubble (mono font, no border colour).

what: The history bubble labelled "You" always shows the right answer, even when the learner first picked a wrong one.
evidence: Pick wrong then right in ch-dka step 1; step 2 history: "You: Venous gas, then start fluids..."
fix: Label it "Decision" or show "You (2nd try)" when tried has more than one key.

what: The "Untagged" exam chip always gives "No case matches", because every case has an exam tag.
evidence: caseList with exam=none -> n=0.
fix: Only render the Untagged chip when CASES.some(c=>!(c.exam||[]).length), as the setting chips already do.

what: The curare cleft is drawn identically, deep (~35% of amplitude) and early on every breath; real clefts sit in the later plateau and vary breath to breath.
evidence: Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T21-im-capno-s3-1280-dark.png.
fix: Move the notch to 0.42–0.50 of the cycle, depth ~15–20%, and vary depth per breath (e.g. [18,10,22,14]px).

what: aria-label announces 'chocolate-brown blood', handing screen-reader users the answer, while capno's label ('Capnography trace') gives them nothing.
evidence: Source of syringeSVG / capnoSVG.
fix: Neutral but useful labels: 'Blood gas syringe; colour shown in the swatch' and a shape description for capno only in the explanation.

what: Timed sim: the tab bar stays visible while the clock runs; action buttons are inline-wrapped with ragged widths; the group headings (Tests / Treatment / Call for help) touch the button above with no top margin; on desktop the short Results card sits beside a long Actions column with a large empty area under it.
evidence: openCase('sim-dka') at 390×844 and 1280×800. Shots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-sim-390x844-pixel-dark-end.png, /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-sim-1280x800-pixel-dark.png.
fix: Add body.insession while a sim runs. Lay actions out as `.acts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr))}` with full-width buttons; give the group h3 `margin:12px 0 6px`; make the Results/Events column sticky on ≥861 px.

what: The four filter groups take the whole first phone screen (Presentation alone wraps into five rows), so no case is visible without scrolling.
evidence: go('cases') at 390×844. Shot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-cases-390x844-pixel-dark.png.
fix: Under 560 px, render each group as a single horizontally scrolling chip row (`.seg{flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:auto}`), or collapse filters behind a 'Filter (0)' button.

where: image cases · gap above the image
what: Image-led cases show a larger gap (about 50 px) between the intro card and the image card than between other cards. Probably the empty .chat container (margin 12px 0) plus the view gap. (Doubt: cause not confirmed in the DOM.)
evidence: openCase('im-capno'), 'im-syringe', 'im-dip' at 390×844. Shots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-case-img-390x844-pixel-dark.png.
fix: Do not render an empty .chat container for image cases, or use `.chat:empty{display:none}`.

where: reload mid timed sim / mid chat case
what: Reload restarts a timed sim at 00:00 and a chat case at step 1 without saying so; wrong turns already logged stay in the notebook. This is acceptable, but the user is not told.
evidence: openCase('sim-sepsis'), wait 6 s, act, reload: CS.t goes 3→0. Chat case ch-dka also restarts at 1/4.
fix: Keep CS (minus Sets) in sessionStorage and offer 'Resume where you were' or 'Start again'.

what: Notebook entries keep the question and both answers but not the "What happens" explanation, and "Redo the case" restarts from step 1.
evidence: S.cmist entry fields: id,key,cid,ct,q,a,r,d,u.
fix: Store the explanation (x.e=st.o[i][2]). Add "Retry this step", which opens the case at CS.i=step with previous steps auto-filled.

what: There is no link from a finished case to the matching lessons or tools, though the app has them (HAGMA lesson, osmolar gap tool, Winter's gym).
evidence: caseEnd renders only sources and two buttons.
fix: Add a "Go deeper" row built from c.dis (e.g. hagma -> openLesson("hagma"), the osmolar gap tool for ch-meth).

what: Learners cannot open a case gas in the interpreter to check their working.
evidence: slip() is rendered without an action.
fix: After the step is solved, add "Open in interpreter" (prefill from st.gas). This also exposes the ch-asa chronic/acute nuance, which the explanation should then address.

what: Three-number panel: SpO₂, analyser-calculated sO₂ (from PaO₂) and co-oximeter FO₂Hb, with the question 'which number is right?'. Teaches the saturation gap that MetHb, CO and sulfHb share.
evidence: Toffaletti 2007.
fix: Extend monitorSVG with an optional calc row.

what: A generic analyser screen (not a brand) with error/flag states: 'clot detected', 'insufficient sample', '?' flags, 'Sample type: not selected', haemolysis index → spurious K⁺. Trains real-world sample rejection.
evidence: Brief's suggestion; AARC 2013 pre-analytical errors.
fix: New img type 'screen'; 3–4 steps.

what: capnoSVG supports a normal trace but no step uses it. Show a faint normal strip above each abnormal trace, or add a step 0 asking the learner to tap phases I–IV.
fix: Pass k:'normal' as a reference layer or new first step.

what: The svg labels are generic ("Capnography trace", "Urine dipstick"). The question text describes the trace, so this is mitigated, but a descriptive label helps screen-reader users and anyone who cannot see the image.
evidence: ui8.js capnoSVG: aria-label is fixed.
fix: Build the label from k: shark → "Capnograph: slow sloping upstroke, no flat plateau (shark fin)"; flat → "flat line, no waveform"; cleft → "plateau with a notch". Dipstick: list the pad results.

what: On 360×640 the clock and vitals fill the first screen, and while scrolling actions you lose sight of the vitals.
evidence: Shot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-sim-360x640-pixel-dark.png.
fix: Under 560 px, make a compact sticky vitals strip (time · HR · BP · SpO₂ · severity bar) at the top while the sim runs.

what: (3) The sims never ask the learner to read the gases they order, yet this is a blood-gas app.
evidence: Learner session, 13/11/2026
fix: When a gas result arrives, pause and ask a 1-question read (primary, compensation, the one number that matters). In the debrief, chart the serial gases (lactate clearance %, pH, HCO₃⁻) and mark the reads that were right or wrong.
